tool_limitations.limitation: It rewrites only the Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml namespace, but leaves the sample's own root namespace 'SDKTemplate' untouched while the WinUI scaffold's App/MainWindow live in the project-name namespace. The resulting mismatch is not reconciled by any mechanical step, so the agent had to fix it by hand across many files and several build rounds.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a reconciliation step that rewrites the standalone 'SDKTemplate' namespace token to the scaffold's root namespace across all copied .cs/.xaml (namespace decls, using directives, x:Class, xmlns:local) before the agent builds.

special_apis.special_handling: The project/root namespace is named after the sensor (Barometer), so the WinRT type 'Barometer' is shadowed by the project namespace, producing CS0118 'Barometer is a namespace but is used like a type'. Fixed with 'using BarometerSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Barometer;' alias.

errors_encountered.error: error CS0118: 'Barometer' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario1_DataEvents.xaml.cs, Scenario2_Polling.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Project root namespace == WinRT type name (Barometer). Common in sensor/device SDK samples whose project is named after the device type they consume.
errors_encountered.fix: Add 'using BarometerSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Barometer;' alias (or fully-qualify) and use the alias for the field type, GetDefault(), and TypedEventHandler<...> generic args.

errors_encountered.error: error CS0246: The type or namespace name 'SDKTemplate' could not be found (MainWindow.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Sample files declare 'namespace SDKTemplate' while the scaffold's App/MainWindow are in the project-name namespace; references to SDKTemplate.* don't resolve.
errors_encountered.fix: Reconcile all files to one namespace (rename SDKTemplate -> project root namespace across .cs and .xaml).

errors_encountered.error: error CS0103: The name 'App' does not exist in the current context (Scenario1_DataEvents.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Scenario pages were still in 'namespace SDKTemplate' but the scaffold's App class is in the project-name namespace, so 'App.MainWindow' could not be resolved.
errors_encountered.fix: Move scenario pages into the project root namespace (same SDKTemplate reconciliation).

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler error WMC0909: Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario / WMC1111: DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType (MainPage.xaml)
errors_encountered.root_cause: x:Class/xmlns:local in the copied XAML still pointed at 'SDKTemplate', so the x:Bind DataType 'local:Scenario' resolved against the wrong namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: Update x:Class and xmlns:local='using:SDKTemplate' to the project root namespace in every copied .xaml at the same time as the .cs files.

dev_agent_struggles.where: session-log.txt turns 26-45 (build rounds at lines 2412, 2799, 3280; success at 3679)
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Three consecutive failed builds, each surfacing a new facet of the same namespace mismatch (CS0118, then CS0246/CS0103, then x:Bind WMC errors). 33 separate SDKTemplate edits.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Two compounding, fully generalizable issues left unhandled by the bootstrap: (1) sample root namespace 'SDKTemplate' not reconciled to the scaffold's project namespace; (2) project name collides with the WinRT type it uses.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent hand-edited namespace decls, usings, x:Class and xmlns:local across MainPage, SampleConfiguration and both scenario files, and added a sensor-type alias.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: (1) Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 reconciling the SDKTemplate namespace to the scaffold root namespace automatically; (2) a documented MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md entry for the project-name vs WinRT-type CS0118 collision with the alias fix.
